name: draftsman
description: The parser measures, the agent drafts. UML class diagrams for Java, C#, Kotlin, TypeScript, Python and C++ — every relation traced to source, never guessed. Mermaid, SVG or an interactive HTML viewer.

interface.shortDescription: Class diagrams drawn from parser facts, not guesses
interface.longDescription: Draftsman extracts types, members and relations with tree-sitter (Java, C#, Kotlin, TypeScript, Python, C++), lets the agent choose scope, grouping and commentary, and renders Mermaid, a static SVG, or a single-file interactive HTML viewer. Relations the parser did not find are only ever drawn as visibly inferred.
defaultPrompt: Draw a class diagram of this repository
Show the classes around OrderService as an interactive diagram
Which classes form dependency cycles here?
